rationale: Retain STRATOS as the directly invested project-level PortCo, preserve legacy BlackRock Diversified Infrastructure as the active noncontrolling infrastructure investor, add Occidental as the consolidating co-owner through 1PointFive, and reject a separate GIP ownership period. BlackRock's acquisition of GIP changed the manager platform but did not transfer STRATOS.

companyFieldUpdates.description: STRATOS is a direct-air-capture and geologic-sequestration infrastructure project in Ector County, Texas, owned through a joint venture between Occidental and a fund managed by legacy BlackRock Diversified Infrastructure. Occidental develops and operates the project through 1PointFive and consolidates the venture; BlackRock is the active noncontrolling infrastructure investor and committed $550 million at entry in November 2023. The facility is designed to capture up to 500,000 tonnes of carbon dioxide per year and use three permitted Class VI wells for permanent saline sequestration. Public sources do not disclose the owners' exact economic percentages, the BlackRock fund name, a separate STRATOS headquarters, or a legal commercial-operation date. No sale or signed ownership transfer was found through August 23, 2026.
